Govardhan Parvat: Krishna Ki Chhoti Ungli Ka Kamaal! 🏔️

🔱 Krishna lifted Govardhan mountain on little finger defeating Indra

To humble Indra's pride and shield the residents of Braj from catastrophic torrential rains, Lord Krishna lifted the colossal Govardhan hill upon his left little finger for seven consecutive days.

👉 Govardhan Puja — prakriti aur paryavaran ki raksha ka divya sandesh!
